healthcare.summary: In May 2026 he and Congressman Boyle introduced legislation in the Pennsylvania and U.S. House urging the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to issue operational guidance on scheduled Medicaid cuts, and he said officials have a duty to ensure vulnerable constituents have access to healthcare.
healthcare.short: Introduced legislation on Medicaid cuts; says officials must protect healthcare access.

guns.summary: He sponsored House Bill 1936, passed by the House in February 2026, requiring courts to count all time a youth spends in secure detention toward their sentence, which he said provides justice while keeping communities safe. The measure concerns juvenile sentencing, not firearms.
guns.short: Sponsored juvenile-sentencing bill he says keeps communities safe; not firearms.
